To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the nucleotide and the deduced amino acid sequence of a cDNA clone encoding an Arabidopsis thioredoxin have been determined.
we isolated a cDNA clone encoding an A. thalianathioredoxin h.
thioredoxih proteins have been isolated from several plant species and that they are encoded by a small multigene family.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of cDNA and genomic clones encoding thioredoxin proteins from A. thalianathi thioredoxin f and thioredoxin m (Brugidoux et al., 3 1993).
the molecular and genetic analysis of the regulation of gene expression in higher plants.
the identification and characterization of the thioredoxin system of higher plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
thioredox h proteins are related, and the homology is greater with the vertebrate thioredox than with chloroplastic thiorexins.
thioredoxih proteins from higher plants are related to the cytoplasmic type and not to the chloroplastic thiodeoxins.
thioredox h is the only thioredoxin that is not chloroplastic, and that it is the only one to have been shown to be NADPH dependent (Florencio et al.,1988; Marcus et al.,1991).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the thioredoxin gene family in plants is as large as that found in vertebrates and that the two thioredoxinh proteins in Arabidopsis are related.
thioredox h proteins from plants are more related to the cytoplasmic than to the chloroplastic thiodeoxins, and this is true for all the thioredoxns known to date.
the thioredoxin family is composed of two main subgroups.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thioredoxin system is highly conserved in plants.
the thioredoxih gene is a single copy in the Arabidopsis genome and is expressed at the same time during the life cycle as the thioredoxin m and f genes.
we have shown that the thioredoxin system is present in all plant tissues and is not limited to photosynthetic cells.
